Folks —

Forwarding Sarah’s note. A few internal recommendations before we reply with a timeline:

1) Sizing validation (staging):
   - Replay 72 hours of sampled prod traffic into staging with live KV cache emulation
   - Validate 95/99 p99 latencies for the main prompt paths

2) Dry-run checklist (we should include):
   - Health checks (container, GPU temp, mem pressure)
   - KV cache hit rate baseline
   - Thundering herd / burst simulation for cold-starts

3) Rollback / fallback plan:
   - Automatic fallback to hosted model variant (same model family, lower-capacity nodes) if 5xx > 1% over 10min or p99 latency > 2x SLA target
   - Pre-approved credits and support contact for fast escalation (CS on-call + infra on-call)

I’ll draft a one-page dry-run-checklist.md and drop it in the Drive link. Suggest we propose a 3-week runway from acceptance to full cutover to allow for an audit pass and billing alignment.
